headline: Wardens Reclaim Northern Strongholds as Stonecradle and Linn Flare
war_summary: Since the mid-afternoon dispatch, Warden forces have reversed earlier Colonial inroads, reclaiming all ten redoubts in Callahan’s Passage and securing complete mastery over Mooring County. To the west, Stonecradle suddenly flared into violent contest, recording seven rapid base transitions within two hours that left one stronghold leveled to no-man's-land between The Reach and The Dais. Heavy fighting also erupted along the central front in Linn of Mercy, where three swift transfers at Lathair sent casualty rates climbing sharply. On the Nevish Line, repeated assaults around Princefal have trimmed the Colonial holding to a solitary outpost, while Weathered Expanse endures unabated bloodletting, claiming over thirty-one hundred casualties in two hours amid five base shifts across Crow’s Nest and Shattered Advance. Meanwhile, earlier flashpoints have cooled down significantly; the fighting in Fisherman’s Row has halted entirely, and Viper Pit remains dormant following the Warden recovery of Moltworth.
